notes.title: GSC Game World Birthday Sale
notes.notes:
Digital battles between players in the «Cossacks» universe continue. The screech of metal and shots of bullets fly through the years and battlefields where new players are still arriving.

The coast still remembers the boots of the teams of pioneers who went to explore the new lands in the «American Conquest». The cries of orcs, elves, and druids on the island of Atlans did not stop for a moment… A thousand warriors and mages go side by side into the last battle to reach the Ark in «Heroes of Annihilated Empires».

Well, the Zone never changes. She is still waiting for the one who is ready to challenge her and find out what is the true S.T.A.L.K.E.R. Wish Granter.

Thousands of players have passed through those Universes and made their own personal contribution to our mutual history, the history of GSC Game World. But if you haven't yet conquered the Zone, met the fearless elves, or prepared your city for defense, the upcoming GSC Game World birthday sale from December 5 to 12 will be a good opportunity to replenish your library with new projects.

Thank you, and happy winter game nights, dear players.

notes.title: Humble Bundle bringing a bundle per day, starting with Deep Silver
notes.notes: Humble Bundle is rolling out a new bundle every day for the next two weeks, including revivals of older bundles and some brand new ones. New ones will become available daily at 11 AM PT until May 27, and it just kicked off with a revised version of last year's Deep Silver bundle.
